core_thesis: A GPU-native differentiable high-fidelity LES can directly solve receding-horizon wind-farm yaw trajectories within the online budget. With temporal, terminal, movement and execution constraints defined without lookup-controller participation, pure LES-MPC must deliver statistically reliable net-energy improvement over both no-yaw control and the strong causal B1P*(F) external baseline under matched dynamic-inlet conditions.

allowed_runtime_inputs: current actuator state and active target
previous valid pure-MPC solution for shifted warm start
forbidden_b1pstar_roles: terminal target or terminal value reference

historical_evidence_policy.allowed_use: historical outcome-exposed method-development and mechanism evidence only
historical_evidence_policy.forbidden_use: headline evidence for pure LES-MPC replacement of lookup control

mandatory_preexperiment_gate.launch_rule: No process, container, GPU job or scored local experiment may start unless the machine-readable adjudication status is pass and authorized_to_launch is true.
mandatory_preexperiment_gate.misalignment_rule: Any missing field, mainline hash mismatch, online B1Pstar dependency, unapproved fallback or unstated pass/fail evidence is fail_closed.
mandatory_preexperiment_gate.off_mainline_rule: An experiment that does not pass this gate requires a new explicit user-approved mainline amendment; relabelling it after outcomes are visible is forbidden.

strongest_objection: Removing the strong causal lookup anchor may reduce or reverse the previously observed energy effect. That risk is part of the scientific question and must be tested; it cannot be concealed by continuing a hybrid controller under a pure-MPC label.
claim_boundary: Controlling project research mainline and pre-experiment governance only. This freeze contains no new controller implementation, energy result, timing result, confirmation result or field-deployment evidence.
